organization.name: FixMyWeb
organization.description: FixMyWeb is a web development and digital growth platform that helps businesses enhance their online presence, performance, and lead generation through modern digital solutions.

mission: To help businesses grow digitally by improving their online presence, performance, visibility, and customer engagement through smart web and marketing solutions.

services.name: Website Audit & Analysis
services.description: Comprehensive website audit to identify performance issues, SEO gaps, UI/UX problems, and technical errors with actionable insights.

services.name: Website Design & Development
services.description: Professional website design and development including business websites, landing pages, and custom solutions focused on conversions.

services.name: SEO & Search Engine Optimization
services.description: Improves website ranking and visibility on search engines through on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.

services.name: Google My Business (GMB) Optimization
services.description: Optimizes local business presence on Google Maps and search results to increase visibility, calls, and local leads.

services.name: Social Media Setup & Management
services.description: Creation and optimization of social media profiles with content strategy to boost engagement and brand presence.

services.name: Paid Ads Management
services.description: Setup and management of paid advertising campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Meta Ads to generate leads and sales.

services.name: AI Chatbot Development
services.description: Custom AI chatbot development for websites and businesses to automate customer interaction, lead capture, and support.

digital_services.name: Website Performance & Speed Optimization
digital_services.description: Enhances website loading speed, responsiveness, and overall performance to improve user experience and SEO ranking.

digital_services.name: Conversion Rate Optimization
digital_services.description: Improves website structure and user journey to increase leads, conversions, and customer engagement.

digital_services.name: Digital Growth Strategy
digital_services.description: Strategic planning for online growth including analytics, funnel building, and performance tracking.

digital_services.name: Branding & Online Presence
digital_services.description: Helps businesses build a strong online identity through consistent branding across website and digital platforms.

how_it_works.title: Requirement Analysis
how_it_works.description: Understanding business goals, current digital presence, and key challenges.

how_it_works.title: Audit & Strategy Planning
how_it_works.description: Performing website audit and creating a custom strategy for development, SEO, and growth.

how_it_works.title: Execution & Optimization
how_it_works.description: Implementing website improvements, SEO, ads, and automation solutions.

how_it_works.title: Monitoring & Growth
how_it_works.description: Continuous tracking, optimization, and scaling of digital performance.

service_scope_notes: All services are provided as professional consultancy and execution support based on business requirements.
Specific tools, timelines, pricing, and deliverables are finalized after requirement analysis.
The chatbot provides high-level guidance and does not replace expert consultation.

faqs.question: What is FixMyWeb?
faqs.answer: FixMyWeb is a web development and digital growth platform that helps businesses improve their website, SEO, performance, and online presence.

faqs.question: Who can use FixMyWeb?
faqs.answer: Startups, local businesses, MSMEs, entrepreneurs, and brands looking to grow digitally can use FixMyWeb.

faqs.question: What services does FixMyWeb provide?
faqs.answer: Services include website audit, website development, SEO, GMB optimization, social media management, paid ads, and AI chatbot development.

faqs.question: Do you provide website development services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we create professional and conversion-focused websites tailored to business needs.

faqs.question: Do you offer SEO services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide complete SEO solutions to improve rankings and organic traffic.

faqs.question: Can you manage ads for my business?
faqs.answer: Yes, we run and optimize paid ad campaigns on Google and Meta platforms.

faqs.question: Do you provide chatbot development?
faqs.answer: Yes, we develop AI chatbots for automation, lead capture, and customer support.

faqs.question: Do you provide detailed technical execution through chatbot?
faqs.answer: No, detailed execution is handled by experts after requirement discussion.
